app.name: Elo SDK Docs
app.short_description: Search Elo SDK documentation without leaving the ticket.
app.long_description: Embeds the searchable Elo SDK docs site (EloView Device Level, PayPoint Peripherals, SLK, and other SDKs) in the ticket sidebar and top bar, so agents can look up classes/methods while working a ticket.
app.installation_instructions: After installing, open this app's settings and set 'docsUrl' to the Elo SDK Docs site's URL (e.g. https://elo-sdk-docs-production.up.railway.app, no trailing slash).

docsUrl.label: Docs site URL
docsUrl.helpText: Base URL of the Railway-hosted Elo SDK Docs site (no trailing slash), e.g. https://elo-sdk-docs-production.up.railway.app
